ae5ed1ada1a1e815a2c94077152490ba179b4c4e.summary: A GitHub repository by an individual (cdong1012) containing a Python tool called ContiUnpacker. It uses the Speakeasy Emulation Framework to try to unpack a packed Conti ransomware sample found on MalwareBazaar. The author says the tool does not work fully: only parts of a section are written during emulation, so the dumped executable may not run. The repository page was archived on 2026-11-25. It is a tool write-up, not a vendor threat report.

tools.q: The unpacker uses the Speakeasy Emulation Framework to run and unpack the sample.

hedges: I can't figure out why this is happening because Speakeasy is pretty weird, so this unpacker does not work 100%.
